job.job_description:
We are seeking an experienced Lead Engineer to drive the development and implementation of cutting-edge AI solutions (Generative AI, Agentic AI). This role combines hands-on technical leadership with strategic vision, requiring someone who can architect scalable AI systems, mentor engineering teams, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders to deliver innovative solutions from concept to production.







Essential functions





Lead software development projects from concept to production and beyond, define and design architecture of AI solutions and drive implementation (including hands-on work together with the team)

Set technical direction, establish best practices for engineering teams, and mentor other engineers

Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to understand strategic needs, align technical efforts and deliver highly effective AI solutions

Acts as the bridge between business/product stakeholders and the engineering team, communicate complex technical concepts to to non-technical stakeholders

Stay up-to-date with latest AI industry trends and integrate emerging technologies to drive innovation and improve system performance, but at the same time balance innovation with operational pragmatism







Qualifications





Over 6+ years of professional experience developing production-grade AI/ML systems

Proven team lead experience (2+ years), familiar with Agile methodologies.

1+ year of hands-on experience delivering production-ready Agentic AI solutions

Proficient in Python programming and its ecosystem, particularly for web, AI/ML and data engineering

Deep expertise in LLMs: open/closed-source models, advanced prompt engineering techniques, RAG, Agentic AI, document processing, vector/hybrid search, guardrails, observability & monitoring, LLM fine-tuning and evaluation

Experience in delivering AI/ML projects from POC to production with continuous improvements and support

Strong expertise with at least one major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and related ML platforms (e.g. Vertex AI)

Excellent communication and leadership skills with the ability to lead discussions with clients and other teams







Would be a plus





Practical experience in modern end-to-end projects beyond AI/ML - frontend, backend, data engineering, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, monitoring and observability

Hands-on experience with Deep Learning (NLP, Computer Vision, etc.) and popular frameworks such as PyTorch and Hugging face







We offer







Opportunity to work on bleeding-edge projects


Work with a highly motivated and dedicated team


Competitive salary


Flexible schedule


Benefits package - medical insurance, sports


Corporate social events


Professional development opportunities


Well-equipped office
